title: Flerp's Exploration Data
description: Data required by Flerp's Exploration Pack
body:
This data pack adds:
- recipe unlock advancements to Alex's Caves, reducing the need to check the wiki during play
- Create cutting recipes for logs from Alex's Caves
- Create mixing recipes for Acidic Radrock and Toxic Paste from Alex's Caves
- a Create washing recipe for Uranium Shards from Alex's Caves

This data pack was created for use in Flerp's Exploration Pack, but can be used in any mod pack that contains any of the mods mentioned.
